manifest_summary.approach: Frozen reused strategy for both rounds: require 41 public bars. Enter flat only when 20- and 40-bar returns and close/SMA20-1 are all >0.003; exit held only when all three are < -0.003. Otherwise hold, no topups. Buy floor1e-10[cash/(decision_close*(1+max(0.12,4*sigma40))*(1.0005)*(1.001))], sell held quantity. Sigma40 is sample standard deviation of last 40 log returns. Only supplied public bars inform decisions; volume unused. Unknown next-close fill is not observed. Reserve cannot guarantee feasibility after an arbitrary gap. Long only, no leverage. Only routine settlement counts.
